instruction:
You are a civil drainage engineer checking a task-owned synthetic stormwater sewer/storm pipe gradient and capacity repair package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Manning pipe capacity, pipe invert schedule review, storm pipe repair workflows, and gravity pipe velocity checks shape the workflow context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product family: `SSC-03-LH-07`
- Pipe schedule: `PIPE-SSC03-007`
- Invert table: `INVERT-SSC03-007`
- Long section: `LONG-SSC03-007`
- Capacity criteria: `CRIT-SSC03-007`
- Network correction memo: `MEMO-SSC03-007`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Scheduled upstream invert | {{ scheduled_upstream_invert_m }} m |
| Scheduled downstream invert | {{ scheduled_downstream_invert_m }} m |
| Long-section downstream invert | {{ long_section_downstream_invert_m }} m |
| Pipe length | {{ pipe_length_m }} m |
| Pipe diameter | {{ pipe_diameter_m }} m |
| Manning n | {{ manning_n }} |
| Design flow | {{ design_flow_m3_s }} m3/s |
| Invert conflict tolerance | {{ invert_conflict_tolerance_m }} m |
| Surface level | {{ surface_level_m }} m |
| Pipe outer diameter | {{ pipe_outer_diameter_m }} m |
| Minimum cover | {{ minimum_cover_m }} m |
| Minimum velocity | {{ minimum_velocity_m_s }} m/s |
| Maximum velocity | {{ maximum_velocity_m_s }} m/s |

## Checks

- Scheduled slope uses scheduled upstream and downstream inverts.
- Long-section slope uses scheduled upstream invert and long-section downstream invert.
- Manning capacity uses full-pipe area, hydraulic radius, and scheduled slope.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when invert conflict, capacity, velocity, and cover checks pass; otherwise it is `0.0`.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the object IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated SWMM report-output evidence, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "scheduled_slope_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "long_section_slope_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "invert_conflict_m": <numeric_value>,
  "manning_capacity_m3_s": <numeric_value>,
  "capacity_margin_m3_s": <numeric_value>,
  "flow_velocity_m_s": <numeric_value>,
  "velocity_low_margin_m_s": <numeric_value>,
  "velocity_high_margin_m_s": <numeric_value>,
  "pipe_crown_cover_m": <numeric_value>,
  "cover_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
# ABOUTME: Defines the stormwater sewer/storm pipe gradient and capacity repair template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one synthetic pipe schedule, invert, long-section, and repair criteria source package.

[meta]
name = "sewer-storm-pipe-gradient-capacity-repair-package"
description = "stormwater pipe slope, invert conflict, Manning capacity, velocity, and cover metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound sewer/storm pipe repair metrics from a deterministic stormwater task-owned source pack. The template combines scheduled and long-section slopes, invert conflict, Manning capacity, velocity margins, pipe cover, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "civil"
category = "pipe-gradient-repair"
standards = ["Manning pipe capacity", "pipe invert schedule review", "storm pipe repair workflows", "gravity pipe velocity checks"]
tags = ["civil", "stormwater", "sewer", "pipe-gradient", "capacity", "repair", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.scheduled_upstream_invert_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "INVERT-SSC03-007 scheduled upstream invert"
min = 18.42
max = 18.42

[params.scheduled_downstream_invert_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "INVERT-SSC03-007 scheduled downstream invert"
min = 17.94
max = 17.94

[params.long_section_downstream_invert_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "LONG-SSC03-007 long-section downstream invert"
min = 17.935
max = 17.935

[params.pipe_length_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "PIPE-SSC03-007 pipe reach length"
min = 96.0
max = 96.0

[params.pipe_diameter_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "PIPE-SSC03-007 hydraulic pipe diameter"
min = 0.6
max = 0.6

[params.manning_n]
type = "float"
description = "PIPE-SSC03-007 Manning roughness"
min = 0.013
max = 0.013

[params.design_flow_m3_s]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/s"
description = "PIPE-SSC03-007 design flow"
min = 0.34
max = 0.34

[params.invert_conflict_tolerance_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "MEMO-SSC03-007 invert conflict tolerance"
min = 0.01
max = 0.01

[params.surface_level_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "LONG-SSC03-007 surface level at upstream end"
min = 19.65
max = 19.65

[params.pipe_outer_diameter_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "PIPE-SSC03-007 pipe outer diameter for cover"
min = 0.65
max = 0.65

[params.minimum_cover_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "CRIT-SSC03-007 minimum cover"
min = 0.45
max = 0.45

[params.minimum_velocity_m_s]
type = "float"
unit = "m/s"
description = "CRIT-SSC03-007 minimum velocity"
min = 0.75
max = 0.75

[params.maximum_velocity_m_s]
type = "float"
unit = "m/s"
description = "CRIT-SSC03-007 maximum velocity"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[outputs.scheduled_slope_percent]
description = "Pipe slope from scheduled inverts"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.long_section_slope_percent]
description = "Pipe slope from long-section invert"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.invert_conflict_m]
description = "Absolute difference between scheduled and long-section downstream invert"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.manning_capacity_m3_s]
description = "Full-pipe Manning capacity"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.capacity_margin_m3_s]
description = "Manning capacity minus design flow"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.flow_velocity_m_s]
description = "Pipe flow velocity"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.velocity_low_margin_m_s]
description = "Flow velocity minus minimum velocity"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.velocity_high_margin_m_s]
description = "Maximum velocity minus flow velocity"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.pipe_crown_cover_m]
description = "Cover above pipe crown"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.cover_margin_m]
description = "Pipe crown cover minus minimum cover"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "Pass score for invert, capacity, velocity, and cover checks"
tolerance = 0.03

[archetypes.stormwater_pipe_gradient_repair_case]
description = "Sewer/storm pipe gradient and capacity repair case"
scheduled_upstream_invert_m = {min = 18.42, max = 18.42}
scheduled_downstream_invert_m = {min = 17.94, max = 17.94}
long_section_downstream_invert_m = {min = 17.935, max = 17.935}
pipe_length_m = {min = 96.0, max = 96.0}
pipe_diameter_m = {min = 0.6, max = 0.6}
manning_n = {min = 0.013, max = 0.013}
design_flow_m3_s = {min = 0.34, max = 0.34}
invert_conflict_tolerance_m = {min = 0.01, max = 0.01}
surface_level_m = {min = 19.65, max = 19.65}
pipe_outer_diameter_m = {min = 0.65, max = 0.65}
minimum_cover_m = {min = 0.45, max = 0.45}
minimum_velocity_m_s = {min = 0.75, max = 0.75}
maximum_velocity_m_s = {min = 3.0, max = 3.0}
site_contexts = ["pipe-gradient", "capacity-repair-check"]

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All source-pack values given for the stormwater pipe gradient repair package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["stormwater_pipe_gradient_repair_case"]
